work_unit: exp-20260825-001 iBorrowDesk apex->www host fault recovery
summary: The iBorrowDesk borrow-economics fetch pipeline had been fully dead since ~2026-07-21: the upstream site moved to www.iborrowdesk.com and the apex host drops /api requests with empty replies (RemoteDisconnected), so every daily refresh aborted after 5 consecutive failures, the PIT borrow archive froze, and every news-propagation pair forward-readiness batch fail-closed on stale_pit_borrow (covered_tickers=0). One-line API_URL repoint to the www host; 5 unit tests pass; targeted refresh of the 10 blocked short-side tickers 10/10 succeeded (+263 rows, archived through 2026-08-24, within the 3-calendar-day freshness bar); a standard 150-shard added +2580 rows across 89 tickers before hitting the www rate limit (http_444 after ~90 req at 1 req/s; abort-early resumable).
wrong_label_repair: close facade defaulted to rejected on null Gate-4 metrics and --status-override failed on the already-terminal ticket; hand-edited ticket+log shard to accepted per exp-20260824-001 precedent, rebuilt log, upserted registry cache from the ticket; lean-strict audit passed.
residual_blockers: microcap batch short-side tickers absent from build_default_refresh_universe (missing_pit_borrow persists; iBorrowDesk itself covers them)
rotation cadence cannot guarantee 3-calendar-day borrow freshness for arbitrary batch tickers without targeted daily fetches of active batch short-side tickers
next_gate: d-0003 unchanged: >=1 real measurement_ready batch before the shared paper-policy pair alpha experiment; exp-20260824-001 single-use pair-build qualification unconsumed.
